comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: committed debug scaffolding — `test/cli/zz_debug_it5_test.dart` should be deleted**

This file is a working prototype for IT-5, not a test: it has **zero
assertions** (only `print` probes — "What does the projection see after a
full reload?", `=== COMPACT LINES ===`, an IO-tail dump), a `zz_debug_` name,
and a 5-minute timeout with a 500×5 ms poll loop. It is not
integration-tagged, so it runs in CI's test-core `dart test` sweep on every
PR: it adds real wall time to the shared gate, prints debug noise into CI
logs, feeds `scripts/rebalance_shards.py` bogus shard-duration data, and can
never catch a regression (nothing is asserted — it only fails by timing out
or crashing).

Its coverage intent already lives in
`test/cli/compaction_zero_pass_receipt_test.dart` IT-5 (same seed shape, same
55k usage anchor, same judge/checkpoint fake-stream routing, with real
assertions). Delete this file.

Also note the file is massively unformatted (multiple args-per-line style no
`dart format` produces) — the pre-commit self-heal was bypassed by the WIP
auto-save commit path. Deleting the file resolves that too.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the REG-1 detector claims CI enforcement that does not exist**

The header states: *"A CI job running this detector over a run's diagnostic
log blocks merge when it fires"* — but nothing consumes
`compactionStartWithoutTerminalReceipt` outside its own unit tests and the
new CLI ITs (`grep` over `scripts/`, `.github/`, `bin/`, `tool/`: zero call
sites). The regression signature this card is named after is therefore not
actually gated — a future silent start-loop ships green.

Either wire it (e.g. a CI step that replays a soak/E2E diagnostic log through
the detector, per the "E2E soak replay" mention in the same comment) or reword
the comment to the real contract ("a library helper asserted in the CLI ITs").
If external CI tooling is the intended consumer, also export it from the
`lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` compaction group (every sibling file there is
exported; this one is reachable only via a `src/` import).

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-2237 fix is correct and well-tested — AC1 projection-trust
re-anchor, AC2/AC3 zero-pass receipts, AC5 no-work terminal, HEP bracket close
(18 unit + 3 CLI ITs green locally, 1683 suite tests green, analyze clean);
the ticket contract is met. Two hygiene items gate the lap.

**Key Issues**:
- ⚠️ `test/cli/zz_debug_it5_test.dart` — zero-assertion debug scaffolding
  (only `print` probes) running in CI's test-core sweep on every PR; deletes
  cleanly, IT-5 already covers its intent.
- 💡 `lib/src/compaction/receipt_scan.dart:9` — header claims a CI job blocks
  merge on the REG-1 signature, but nothing calls the detector; wire it or
  reword.

**Next Steps**:
1. Delete `test/cli/zz_debug_it5_test.dart`.
2. Wire `compactionStartWithoutTerminalReceipt` into a CI/log-scan step or
   reword the receipt_scan.dart header to the actual contract.
